_comment: Named parts, each from its manufacturer's own data. This is the list that grows: an entry here is chosen when a board names the part (MPN or LCSC number), and never by value and package alone, because a 100 nF 0402 on a board is not evidence that it is this 100 nF 0402. Every entry MUST cite where its numbers came from - parse() refuses a vendor entry with no source - and the citation is what lets a number be checked or corrected later. Do not copy figures from the generic family and relabel them. 'reference' holds |Z| of the source model at and around its notch, so a test can check that the stored R-L-C still reproduces it. The first parts are the MLCCs on JLCPCB's Basic Parts list (jlcpcb.com parts API, basic library, 2026-09-27) that have manufacturer models; docs/component-library.md lists the ones left out and why, and how to add a part.
